headline: Lenovo Legion 7a gets RTX 5070 12GB GPU for $3,375
summary: Lenovo's Legion 7a laptop now features a 12GB RTX 5070 GPU, paired with a Ryzen AI 9 CPU.
details: Lenovo has updated its Legion 7a 16-inch gaming laptop with a new GPU config: the 12GB version of the RTX 5070 mobile. This upgrade comes at a price, with the new model listed at $3,375 on Best Buy.
The laptop features a flagship Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 CPU, 32GB of LPDDR5X-8000 memory, and a 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD. It also boasts a 2560 x 1600 OLED display with a 240 Hz refresh rate.

The extra 4GB of VRAM in the RTX 5070 should improve performance in modern titles and AI workloads, especially with ray tracing. This upgrade addresses customer complaints about Nvidia's 8GB video memory pools in previous GPUs.

The RTX 5070 in this laptop is rated at a 115W TGP, higher than Nvidia's 100W baseline. However, cheaper laptops with the 12GB RTX 5070 are available, such as Lenovo's Legion 7i with a Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor.
